text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day—a travel show was playing on the 
dorm TV.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooww, this view is wicked pretty~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a hidden hot spring, huh? Sure has a 
nice vibe to it~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu... Spe-chan looks like she's having 
fun today too.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Ah... speaking of hot springs—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You won a hot springs trip voucher at the 
shopping district raffle a while back, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lottery ticket, and hot springs trip 
tickets at that—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
W-Who should I invite...? A trip is a 
pretty big deal and all...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright with you... would you mind 
holding onto this hot spring trip voucher 
for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I've been holding 
onto the Hot Springs Trip Ticket ever 
since then."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't decide how to use it back then, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I've finally made up my mind. Trainer, 
won't you come with me?
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me?
Are you sure you want me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes... If you'd like, I would love to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It felt so nice. So quiet... and so warm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, it was an extremely 
pleasant hot spring. So much so that I 
completely lost track of time...
choice_data_list: I think the heat got to me a bit.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then, that might just be 
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was thinking of going for a 
walk outside after this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Could you come with me for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Silence Suzuka led me was a country 
road stretching on forever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The breeze passes through, feeling so 
pleasant...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason she wanted to go on a hot 
spring trip was apparently because she 
wanted to see the nature surrounding the 
inn.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It feels like the path goes on 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I keep running forward, I bet I'll get 
to see brand new sights one after 
another...
choice_data_list: Are you going for a run now?
Are you going for a run now?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, that was just a figure of 
speech.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I do have the urge to run, but still...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If anything... right now, I'd like to walk 
together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
By your side, at the very same speed as 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was a bit surprised by those unexpected 
words coming from Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Around the time we first met... we looked 
at a view like this together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've run so much— and 
seen so many sights.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes... I'm so fast that I lose sight 
of my surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path I've run until now. Just like the 
bumpy footpath stretching before my eyes, 
it was never a smooth one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Down that very path, for three whole 
years—she dashed forward single-mindedly.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that is why... this is how I feel 
now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking... maybe it's fine to 
just take our time, savoring each step 
like this once in a while."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the new scenery... together with 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka's eyes lit up with 
starlight, twinkling and shimmering.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Going forward, I still want to see even 
more new scenery..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So, when that time comes... please watch 
by my side."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, we walked along the wide path 
between the fields, exchanging words every 
now and then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Silence Suzuka...
